def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the full-height divider, then copy the non-background pattern in

    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    divider = grid[0][sep]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider).most_common(1)[0][0]
    left = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(sep) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    right = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(sep + 1, w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if len(left) >= len(right):
        shift = sep + 1
        for r, c in left:
            out[r][c + shift] = grid[r][c]
    else:
        shift = sep + 1
        for r, c in right:
            out[r][c - shift] = grid[r][c]
    return out
"
}
